title: Cards Christians Like
seoTitle: Cards Christians Like Party Game For Church Groups
blurb: The original Christian party game. 600 cards of hilarious prompts and responses about church and culture.
descriptionHtml:
Discover Cards Christians Like, the hilarious party game designed with convictions. Fill prompts about church and culture with witty responses for hundreds of unique, laugh-out-loud combinations.

With 600 cards — humorous prompt cards paired with funny or edgy responses — it's perfect for teens, adults, families, youth groups, Bible studies, and game nights.

title: Expansion Box Vol. 1
seoTitle: Cards Christians Like Expansion Box Vol. 1
seoDescription: The Expansion Box Vol. 1 is the first 300 card addition to Cards Christians Like. At half the size of the original game, these new cards will have your friends rollin', your parents cryin', and your grandma clutchin' her pearls – not to mention add hours of fresh gameplay. Cards Christians Like base game required for gameplay.

title: Cast The First Stone
seoTitle: Cast The First Stone – The Party Game Where It's Okay to Judge Your Friends
blurb: The game where it's okay to judge your friends. 260 cards of spicy, hilarious gameplay.
descriptionHtml:
Cast The First Stone is a game where it’s okay to judge your friends. Each round, a question is asked, and players cast stones to uncover the truth about their friends.

This game is a great way to relive old memories and laugh at ourselves while embracing some spicy gameplay.

Includes:

  • 160 question cards
  • 90 stone cards
  • 10 identification cards

title: Holy Guacamole
seoTitle: Holy Guacamole Card Game For Family Fun
blurb: The hilarious guessing game for Christian families — explain it, act it out, or say one word. 360 cards.
descriptionHtml: Holy Guacamole is a hilarious card game perfect for Christian families and groups. Experience rounds where rules change from describing to acting, ensuring endless laughter and memorable inside jokes. This engaging game includes 360 cards for hours of fun.

title: Discernment
seoTitle: Discernment Card Game For Christian Group Fun
blurb: What's beneath the babel? Teams race to decode Bible and Christian phrases. 500 cards + sand timer.
descriptionHtml:
Challenge your group with the Discernment Card Game! Teams race to decode biblical or funny Christian phrases written in ‘babel’ for hilarious, faith-filled fun. Perfect for family, youth groups, or church events, this game includes 500 cards and a sand timer.

Buying tip: counterfeit copies of Discernment have appeared from third-party sellers. Use the button below to make sure you're getting the real thing from us on Amazon.

title: CCL Expansion Bundle
blurb: Every Cards Christians Like expansion, bundled together.
descriptionHtml:
The CCL Expansion Bundle brings together the Cards Christians Like expansions for maximum replay value. Start with the Expansion Box Vol. 1 on Amazon — the biggest addition to the game — and check our Amazon storefront for available expansion packs.

Cards Christians Like base game required for gameplay.

descriptionHtml:
